candidates.change: Narrow compute mesh pre-dispatch barrier to compute, fragment and transfer; shader/transfer write access masks.
candidates.decision: Do not port as-is. Source explicitly dismisses vertex/geometry producers as exotic; this is not a dependency proof. Does not cover general attachment writes feeding sampled images either. Need resource producer and hazard tracking or conservative fallback before a general change. No local performance measurement.

candidates.change: Return early for zero-group emulated mesh draws before staging and render-pass break.
candidates.decision: Potentially useful elsewhere, no gain expected from currently observed group counts: private NoSharpening diagnostic logged174000 mesh draws and0empty across whole run. No port or performance claim; that observation does not prove all game scenes nonempty.

other_deltas: Do not import wholesale: RADV gates include satisfied-acquire drain shortcuts, async discard and UMA-specific policies; earlier acquire correctness work and no-missing-geometry constraint still apply.
source_consistency: Web raw main responses did not expose the new barrier despite README claim. Authoritative same-head files and two exact commit patches fetched via GitHub API/raw at immutable SHA before reviewing.
status: Read-only source review. Frozen current emulator unchanged, no build, no native mesh trial, no production change.
